leadText: Harrison's Blaziken (Japanese: ハヅキのバシャーモ Hazuki's Bursyamo) is 's first partner Pokémon.
plainText:
Harrison's Blaziken (Japanese: ハヅキのバシャーモ Hazuki's Bursyamo) is 's first partner Pokémon.

==History==
=== ===
 
Blaziken is 's first partner Pokémon. He revealed to that Professor Birch gave it to him as a when he first started out as a Pokémon Trainer.

It first appeared in Pop Goes The Sneasel. Harrison used it to battle a that was blocking the Sacred Flame of . At that time, Ash's Pokédex had no information on , because it did not come from Kanto or Johto. Blaziken used a lightning fast , followed by a to damage Sneasel. Sneasel's attempt to hit Blaziken with a failed and the knocked it out with a supereffective , allowing Harrison to it.

In Playing with Fire!, it was Harrison's last Pokémon during his Silver Conference Full Battle against Ash. Despite managing to defeat Harrison's Houndoom, she was unable to overcome another type disadvantage. After seeing Blaziken's raw power by kicking down a flurry with its natural kicking abilities, Ash realized he needed to attack Blaziken from a distance to avoid damage to his Bayleef. However, using backfired, as Blaziken seized the vines and reeled Bayleef in, before defeating her with a powerful Fire Punch.
 
Blaziken faced Ash's Charizard in a battle that carried over to the next episode, showing remarkable power and ability to maneuver in mid-air, negating the aerial advantage that Charizard had. It hit hard with a Fire Punch, but was blasted back by Charizard's Flamethrower. Blaziken's Quick Attack was intercepted by Charizard, who landed a devastating . Blaziken kept fighting and landed a to Charizard's neck. Blaziken's Flamethrower countered Charizard's attack and the two were left dazed. Though both Pokémon were able to get back up, Charizard's attempt to use Flamethrower again caused him to go down and ultimately faint, giving Harrison the win and eliminating Ash from the tournament. 

Despite the victory, however, Blaziken was badly injured after its battle with Charizard, so Harrison decided to let it rest during the following round. This led to his loss in his battle with Jon Dickson, who would ultimately go on to win the Silver Conference.

After the tournament, Harrison used Blaziken to destroy one of Team Rocket's mechas.

=== ===
Blaziken reappeared in flashbacks in There's no Place Like Hoenn and Gathering the Gang of Four!.

==Personality and characteristics==
Since Blaziken was Harrison's first Pokémon, Blaziken had a strong bond with him. During the Silver Conference, it helped Harrison get past many of the battles. However, following Harrison's battle with Ash, Blaziken could not battle in the following round since the battle with injured it badly. Its absence ultimately led to Harrison's loss and subsequent elimination from the tournament.

==Moves used==
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Trivia==
Blaziken was the first Pokémon in the animated series to use a Generation III move.
